records.title_zh: 全国碳市场发布2025至2026年度配额分配方案
records.title_en: China issues national ETS allowance allocation plans for 2025 and 2026
records.summary_zh: 生态环境部印发发电行业2025、2026年度以及钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼行业2026年度配额总量和分配方案，并要求各地按期完成配额管理工作。
records.summary_en: China's environment ministry issued allowance allocation plans for the power sector for 2025 and 2026 and for steel, cement and aluminium smelting for 2026, with implementation deadlines for local authorities.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 新版指导目录印发 碳排放计量工具箱更新升级
records.title_en: 新版指导目录印发 碳排放计量工具箱更新升级 - 新华网
records.summary_zh: 市场监管总局、国家发展改革委、生态环境部联合印发《碳排放计量能力建设指导目录（2026版）》，进一步健全全国碳排放计量技术体系。新版目录聚焦钢铁、水泥等传统行业短板，前瞻布局新能源汽车充电设施、温室气体自愿减排项目以及碳捕集利用与封存（CCUS）等前沿领域，通过扩大技术覆盖范围与增加测量仪器设备，为企业碳排放和产品碳足迹精细化核算提供权威技术遵循。
records.source_zh: 中国官方气候来源（GDELT定向发现）
records.source_en: 中国官方气候来源（GDELT定向发现）

records.title_zh: 中国全国碳排放权交易市场累计成交额突破9.3亿吨
records.title_en: China national carbon emissions market sees trading volume top 930 mln tonnes - Xinhua
records.summary_zh: 生态环境部部长黄润秋于周四表示，截至2026年7月底，中国全国碳排放权交易市场累计成交量已超过9.3亿吨。该市场自2021年启动以来，有效降低了相关行业的减碳成本。未来，中国计划将全国碳市场覆盖范围进一步扩大至石化、化工等更多高排放行业，力争将全国约80%的二氧化碳排放纳入有效管控。
records.source_zh: 中国官方气候来源（GDELT定向发现）
records.source_en: 中国官方气候来源（GDELT定向发现）

records.title_zh: 三项自愿减排项目方法学公开征求意见
records.title_en: China consults on three voluntary carbon-credit methodologies
records.summary_zh: 征求意见稿覆盖更新造林碳汇、乔木林经营碳汇和中深层地热能供暖工程，进一步明确自愿减排项目设计、实施、审定及减排量核算核查规则。
records.summary_en: Draft methodologies cover updated afforestation, management of arbor forests and medium-to-deep geothermal heating, refining rules for project design, validation and quantification and verification of emission reductions.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 中国印度拒绝“僵尸碳信用”，新UN市场更严
records.title_en: Most “zombie credits” locked out of new UN carbon market after China and India snub
records.summary_zh: 中国和印度拒绝让旧碳项目转入新联合国碳市场，导致大部分“僵尸碳信用”无法进入。此举缓解了环境质量担忧，有助于提升新市场碳信用的环境可信度。
records.summary_en: Fears of a flood of environmentally-dubious carbon credits have faded, with most old projects not able to transition to new UN market The post Most “zombie credits” locked out of new UN carbon market after China and India snub appeared first on Climate Home News .
records.source_zh: Climate Home News
records.source_en: Climate Home News

records.title_zh: 发电设施碳排放核算、报告与核查技术要求更新
records.title_en: China updates emissions accounting, reporting and verification rules for power facilities
records.summary_zh: 新版技术要求自2026年起用于发电设施碳排放数据管理，调整核算报告和核查指南，并通过全国碳市场管理平台统一处理数据质量控制方案与月度存证。
records.summary_en: Updated requirements apply to power-facility emissions data from 2026, revising accounting, reporting and verification guidance and centralising quality-control plans and monthly evidence on the national ETS platform.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 《产品碳足迹管理体系建设进展报告（2026）》发布
records.title_en: China publishes its 2026 progress report on the product carbon-footprint system
records.summary_zh: 报告集中呈现产品碳足迹核算标准、因子数据、标识认证和国际衔接的制度进展，为产品层级碳核算及供应链减排提供政策依据。
records.summary_en: The report consolidates progress on product carbon-footprint standards, emission-factor data, labelling and certification and international alignment, supporting product-level accounting and supply-chain decarbonisation.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 国家温室气体排放因子数据库第二版发布
records.title_en: China releases the second edition of its national greenhouse-gas emission-factor database
records.summary_zh: 数据库第二版为组织、项目和产品层级温室气体核算提供统一因子基础，有助于减少核算口径差异并提高碳排放数据的可比性。
records.summary_en: The second edition provides a common factor base for organisational, project and product-level greenhouse-gas accounting, improving consistency and comparability across emissions data.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 2026年全国碳市场工作安排明确数据与履约节点
records.title_en: China sets the 2026 national ETS timetable for data management and compliance
records.summary_zh: 通知明确四个已纳入行业的重点排放单位名录、月度存证、年度报告核查、配额分配和年底清缴节点，并将石化、化工、平板玻璃、铜冶炼、造纸和民航纳入排放报告管理。
records.summary_en: The notice sets deadlines for emitter lists, monthly evidence, annual verification, allocation and surrender in four covered sectors, while extending emissions reporting to petrochemicals, chemicals, flat glass, copper smelting, paper and aviation.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 省级温室气体清单编制指南完成更新
records.title_en: China updates its guidelines for provincial greenhouse-gas inventories
records.summary_zh: 2025年版指南在2011年试行版基础上更新，用于提升省级温室气体清单编制的科学性、规范性和可操作性，为地方排放数据体系提供统一方法。
records.summary_en: The 2025 edition updates the 2011 trial guidance to improve the scientific rigour, standardisation and usability of provincial greenhouse-gas inventories and provides a common method for local emissions data.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 2025年全国碳市场覆盖3378家重点排放单位
records.title_en: China's national carbon market covered 3,378 key emitting entities in 2025
records.summary_zh: 2025年全国碳排放权交易市场覆盖发电、钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼四个行业，共纳入3378家重点排放单位，全年运行243个交易日；全国自愿减排市场同期发布12项新方法学。
records.summary_en: In 2025, China's national ETS covered 3,378 key emitters across power generation, steel, cement and aluminium smelting and operated for 243 trading days. The national voluntary market also added 12 methodologies.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 2023年电力二氧化碳排放因子正式发布
records.title_en: China publishes official 2023 electricity carbon-dioxide emission factors
records.summary_zh: 官方电力排放因子为企业用电间接排放和产品碳足迹核算提供年度参数，是统一电力消费碳排放计算口径的重要基础数据。
records.summary_en: The official electricity factors provide annual parameters for corporate indirect emissions and product carbon-footprint calculations, establishing a consistent basis for emissions associated with electricity use.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部与国家统计局
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment and National Bureau of Statistics of China

records.title_zh: 中深层地热井下换热供暖纳入自愿减排方法学
records.title_en: China adopts a voluntary carbon-credit methodology for medium-to-deep geothermal heating
records.summary_zh: 新方法学规范中深层地热能井下换热供暖项目的适用条件、基准线、减排量计算和监测要求，为符合条件的供暖减排项目签发核证自愿减排量提供依据。
records.summary_en: The methodology defines eligibility, baselines, reduction calculations and monitoring for medium-to-deep geothermal well heat-exchange projects, enabling qualifying heating projects to generate verified reductions.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 《全国碳市场发展报告（2025）》发布
records.title_en: Progress Report of China's National Carbon Market (2025)
records.summary_zh: 报告系统梳理强制碳市场、自愿减排市场、配额分配、核算核查和数据基础设施。报告指出，中国正研究符合国情的跨境碳交易管理办法，并拟规范其他自愿减排机制向第六条机制转换的管理要求。
records.summary_en: The official report reviews the national ETS, voluntary market, allocation, MRV and data infrastructure. It says China is studying cross-border trading rules suited to national circumstances and rules for converting reductions from other voluntary mechanisms into Article 6 units.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 中央文件明确全国碳市场2027年和2030年建设目标
records.title_en: China sets 2027 and 2030 milestones for its national carbon market
records.summary_zh: 文件提出，到2027年全国碳排放权交易市场基本覆盖工业领域主要排放行业；到2030年基本建成以总量控制为基础、免费与有偿分配相结合的市场，并形成透明、规范、与国际接轨的自愿减排市场。
records.summary_en: The guideline calls for the national ETS to cover all major industrial emitting sectors by 2027. By 2030, it aims for a cap-based market combining free and paid allocation and a transparent, standardised voluntary market aligned with international standards.
records.source_zh: 中国政府网（英文版）
records.source_en: The State Council of China

records.title_zh: 生态环境部说明全国碳市场配额、金融与核查机制
records.title_en: China explains national ETS allocation, finance and verification arrangements
records.summary_zh: 生态环境部明确2024年度新纳入行业配额按核查排放量分配，2025至2026年度转向强度基准；后续将完善核查机构监管，并稳步推进金融机构参与全国碳市场。
records.summary_en: The ministry said newly covered sectors receive 2024 allowances based on verified emissions before moving to intensity benchmarks for 2025 and 2026. It will strengthen verifier oversight and gradually advance financial-institution participation.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 全国碳市场披露扩围、交易与碳金融下一步安排
records.title_en: China outlines next steps for ETS expansion, trading and carbon finance
records.summary_zh: 截至2025年6月底，全国碳排放配额累计成交6.69亿吨、成交额459.3亿元，扩围后市场管控全国60%以上碳排放量；主管部门将研究更多主体参与、配额有偿分配和碳金融产品。
records.summary_en: By June 2025, cumulative allowance trading reached 669 million tonnes and RMB 45.93 billion, and expansion brought more than 60% of national emissions under the ETS. Authorities are studying broader participation, paid allocation and carbon-finance products.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 生态环境部披露跨境碳交易制度研究方向
records.title_en: China outlines work on a cross-border carbon trading regime
records.summary_zh: 生态环境部表示，中国正在结合《巴黎协定》第六条规则和国内实际研究跨境碳交易管理制度。同期披露的数据显示，截至2025年6月底，全国碳排放配额累计成交6.69亿吨、成交额459.29亿元，核证自愿减排量累计成交219.38万吨。
records.summary_en: China's environment ministry said it is studying a cross-border carbon trading regime consistent with Article 6 and national circumstances. By June 2025, cumulative ETS trading reached 669 million tonnes and RMB 45.929 billion; verified voluntary reductions traded reached 2.1938 million tonnes.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 2025年全国碳市场明确名录、数据质量、配额与清缴安排
records.title_en: China sets the 2025 national ETS schedule for coverage, data quality, allocation and compliance
records.summary_zh: 年度工作通知要求发电、钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼行业中年直接排放达到2.6万吨二氧化碳当量的单位纳入重点排放单位名录，并通过管理平台推进排放报告、核查、配额分配和清缴。
records.summary_en: The annual notice places facilities in power, steel, cement and aluminium smelting with direct annual emissions of at least 26,000 tCO2e on the key-emitter list and sets the reporting, verification, allocation and compliance workflow.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 钢铁、水泥和铝冶炼行业纳入全国碳市场
records.title_en: China expands its national ETS to steel, cement and aluminium smelting
records.summary_zh: 经国务院批准，钢铁、水泥、铝冶炼三个行业纳入全国碳排放权交易市场，覆盖二氧化碳、四氟化碳和六氟化二碳，成为全国碳市场启动后的首次行业扩围。
records.summary_en: With State Council approval, steel, cement and aluminium smelting entered the national ETS, covering carbon dioxide, carbon tetrafluoride and hexafluoroethane in the market's first sectoral expansion.
records.source_zh: 中华人民共和国生态环境部
records.source_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China

records.title_zh: 产品碳足迹核算标准编制工作指引发布
records.title_en: China issues guidance for drafting product carbon-footprint accounting standards
records.summary_zh: 指引规范重点产品碳足迹核算标准的编制程序与技术要求，并提出衔接绿色电力证书、购电协议、数据监测和国际标准，服务供应链碳信息互认。
records.summary_en: The guidance standardises procedures and technical requirements for priority product-footprint standards and addresses green certificates, power-purchase agreements, data monitoring and international alignment to support supply-chain recognition.
records.source_zh: 中国政府网
records.source_en: The State Council of China

records.title_zh: 产品碳足迹国家通则GB/T 24067—2024发布
records.title_en: China publishes national standard GB/T 24067-2024 on product carbon footprints
records.summary_zh: 该标准修改采用ISO 14067:2018，规定产品碳足迹量化要求和指南，2024年10月1日起实施，为重点产品核算规则、碳标识认证和企业供应链数据衔接提供通用基础。
records.summary_en: The standard modifies and adopts ISO 14067:2018 and took effect on 1 October 2024. It provides a common basis for product-level accounting rules, carbon-label certification and supply-chain data.
records.source_zh: 全国标准信息公共服务平台
records.source_en: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information

agencies.name_en: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

agencies.parent_en: Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡与老挝签署《巴黎协定》第六条碳信用实施协议
records.title_en: Singapore and Lao PDR sign an Article 6 implementation agreement on carbon credits
records.summary_zh: 2026年9月4日，新加坡与老挝签署《巴黎协定》第六条下的碳信用实施协议，进一步扩大新加坡政府间碳信用合作网络。
records.summary_en: On 4 September 2026, Singapore and Lao PDR signed an implementation agreement on carbon credits under Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, further expanding Singapore's government-to-government carbon-credit network.
records.source_zh: 新加坡贸工部
records.source_en: Ministry of Trade and Industry

records.title_zh: “超级”厄尔尼诺现象加剧之际，有毒野火烟霾在东南亚蔓延
records.title_en: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
records.summary_zh: 受持续数周的野火影响，印度尼西亚的大规模森林和泥炭地火灾引发了跨国有毒烟霾，并蔓延至马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾。数百万人暴露在严重污染环境中，其中印度尼西亚卫生部记录了超过 5 万起呼吸道感染病例，超过 1.2 万名五岁以下儿童受到影响，部分地区的污染水平超过世界卫生组织推荐标准的 15 倍以上。
records.summary_en: Millions of people have been exposed to the smog, with more than 12,000 children suffering respiratory issues.
records.source_zh: BBC Science & Environment
records.source_en: BBC Science & Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡斥巨资适应气候变化，但森林砍伐仍在继续
records.title_en: Singapore spending billions to adapt to climate change, but deforestation continues
records.summary_zh: 新加坡正准备制定首个国家气候适应计划，以应对气温上升和极端降雨，但该国同时也在为建设住房而清理森林。马裕森林和吉尔曼军营的规划开发引发了罕见的公众抗议，居民指出环境影响评估未能考虑森林在气候适应中的作用，而科学家警告森林消失可能会加剧热岛效应和洪水风险。
records.summary_en: - Singapore is preparing its first national climate adaptation plan as temperatures and extreme rainfall increase, but the city-state is also clearing forests for housing. - The planned development of Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks has triggered rare public protests, with residents arguing that Singapore’s environmental impact assessments fail to account for forests’ role in climate adaptation. - Scientists say forest loss could increase heat and flood risks, while Singapore is spending billions on engineered climate defenses such as drainage, seawalls and heat-resistant paint. - The conflict puts Singapore’s “city in nature” vision under scrutiny, as conservationists question whether tree planting and managed greenery can compensate for the loss of forests.
records.source_zh: Mongabay Climate Change
records.source_en: Mongabay Climate Change

records.title_zh: 新加坡若面临热浪将开放300多个避暑中心：新设酷热办公室
records.title_en: More than 300 cooling centres to open if S’pore faces heatwave: New heat office - The Straits Times
records.summary_zh: 海峡时报报道称，新加坡新成立的酷热办公室宣布，如果该国遭遇热浪袭扰，将开设300多个避暑中心以应对极端高温天气，保障公众健康与安全。
records.summary_en: More than 300 cooling centres to open if S’pore faces heatwave: New heat office The Straits Times
records.source_zh: The Straits Times
records.source_en: The Straits Times

records.title_zh: 新加坡更新本地气候风险关键数据
records.title_en: Singapore updates key evidence on domestic climate risks
records.summary_zh: 1984至2022年新加坡年平均气温每十年上升0.24摄氏度；最新评估预计本世纪末平均海平面上升0.23至1.15米，约30%的国土低于新加坡高程基准5米。
records.summary_en: Singapore's annual mean temperature rose by 0.24°C per decade from 1984 to 2022. Latest assessments project mean sea-level rise of 0.23–1.15 metres by century-end, while about 30% of the island is below five metres Singapore Height Datum.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡审议2028年后的碳税路径
records.title_en: Singapore reviews its carbon-tax trajectory beyond 2027
records.summary_zh: 政府继续以2030年每吨50至80新元为已公布区间，并表示将综合脱碳技术进展、企业成本、国际行动和本国减排进度审议2028年后税率，提前公布结果。
records.summary_en: The government retains its announced S$50–80 per tonne range for 2030 and will review post-2027 rates against technology progress, business costs, international action and domestic decarbonisation, with advance notice to companies.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡重申2030、2035和2050年气候目标
records.title_en: Singapore restates its 2030, 2035 and 2050 climate targets
records.summary_zh: 新加坡目标在2030年将排放降至约6000万吨二氧化碳当量，2035年进一步降至4500万至5000万吨，并在2050年实现净零排放。
records.summary_en: Singapore targets emissions of around 60 MtCO2e in 2030, a further reduction to 45–50 MtCO2e in 2035, and net-zero emissions by 2050.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡已与11个国家签署第六条碳信用实施协议
records.title_en: Singapore has signed Article 6 implementation agreements with 11 countries
records.summary_zh: 截至2026年6月，新加坡已与巴布亚新几内亚、加纳、不丹、智利、秘鲁、卢旺达、巴拉圭、泰国、越南、蒙古和菲律宾签署实施协议，并要求相应调整、独立核算和避免重复计算。
records.summary_en: As of June 2026, Singapore had signed implementation agreements with 11 countries. Its framework requires corresponding adjustments, robust independent accounting and avoidance of double counting.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡推进碳服务与交易枢纽建设
records.title_en: Singapore advances its carbon services and trading hub
records.summary_zh: 新加坡把项目开发、融资、交易、咨询以及监测报告核查纳入碳服务生态，依托专业服务和区域市场连接能力承接《巴黎协定》第六条与自愿碳市场需求。
records.summary_en: Singapore's carbon-services ecosystem covers project development, finance, trading, advisory and MRV, using its professional-services base and regional links to serve Article 6 and voluntary carbon-market demand.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡升级企业气候披露基础设施
records.title_en: Singapore upgrades corporate climate-reporting infrastructure
records.summary_zh: 新加坡将为ESGenome增加国际可持续披露准则模块和自动化核算能力，并把披露数据连接到转型规划、行业基准与供应链管理；该平台已服务逾200家上市公司。
records.summary_en: Singapore will add ISSB-focused modules and automated calculations to ESGenome and connect disclosures with transition planning, sector benchmarks and supply-chain engagement. The platform has supported more than 200 listed companies.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡政府与自愿碳市场诚信委员会深化合作
records.title_en: Singapore Government and ICVCM deepen partnership on high-integrity carbon markets
records.summary_zh: 双方将围绕可信、可互操作和高完整性的碳市场开展能力建设与知识共享，并推进新加坡、肯尼亚和英国共同主持的扩大碳市场联盟工作。
records.summary_en: The agreement covers capacity building and knowledge sharing for credible, interoperable and high-integrity carbon markets and supports the Coalition to Grow Carbon Markets co-chaired by Singapore, Kenya and the United Kingdom.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡收紧受管制产品能效要求
records.title_en: Singapore strengthens energy-efficiency rules for regulated products
records.summary_zh: 自2026年7月起，自用进口的受管制产品也须满足强制能源标签和最低能源性能标准并完成登记，相关广告同时必须显示能源标签。
records.summary_en: From July 2026, regulated products imported for own use must also meet mandatory energy-labelling and minimum-performance standards and be registered, while related advertising must display energy labels.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局
records.source_en: National Environment Agency

records.title_zh: 新加坡预警2026年下半年厄尔尼诺与跨境烟霾风险
records.title_en: Singapore warns of El Niño and transboundary haze risk in the second half of 2026
records.summary_zh: 气象部门判断2026年6月至7月形成厄尔尼诺的概率超过80%，叠加正印度洋偶极子可能使6月至10月更暖、更干，并提高新加坡及周边地区跨境烟霾风险。
records.summary_en: Meteorological authorities put the chance of El Niño developing in June–July 2026 above 80%. Together with a positive Indian Ocean Dipole, it may bring warmer, drier conditions from June to October and greater transboundary haze risk.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局与新加坡气象署
records.source_en: National Environment Agency and Meteorological Service Singapore

records.title_zh: 新加坡将扩大制冷设备高温室效应制冷剂管控
records.title_en: Singapore will expand controls on high-global-warming refrigerants
records.summary_zh: 自2027年7月起，新措施将覆盖大型商业和运输制冷系统以及乘用车、轻型货车空调，并要求相关设备拆解企业登记和规范回收废制冷剂。
records.summary_en: From July 2027, new measures will cover large commercial and transport refrigeration and air-conditioning in passenger cars and light goods vehicles, including registration and proper recovery of spent refrigerants.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局
records.source_en: National Environment Agency

records.title_zh: 新加坡启动Green 100中小企业可持续发展计划
records.title_en: Singapore launches the Green 100 sustainability programme for SMEs
records.summary_zh: 计划推动中小企业采用TR 149:2026框架，首阶段可通过Gprnt免费完成基础披露；已有22家大型企业参与，每家将带动至少100家供应商或合作伙伴。
records.summary_en: The programme promotes SME adoption of TR 149:2026, with free basic disclosure through Gprnt in the first phase. Twenty-two large companies have joined, each seeking to mobilise at least 100 suppliers or partners.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡与世界银行启动碳市场合作计划
records.title_en: Singapore and the World Bank launch a carbon markets programme
records.summary_zh: 合作将开发可互操作碳登记簿和数字化监测报告核查工具，试点碳信用供需聚合，并帮助东道国建设碳市场战略、政策、机构与技术能力。
records.summary_en: The programme will develop interoperable registries and digital MRV tools, pilot aggregation of carbon-credit demand and supply, and help host countries build strategies, policies, institutions and technical capability.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处与世界银行集团
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat and World Bank Group

records.title_zh: 新加坡启动2026气候适应年并推进首份国家适应计划
records.title_en: Singapore launches the Year of Climate Adaptation and develops its first National Adaptation Plan
records.summary_zh: 副总理颜金勇表示，新加坡将首份国家适应计划作为应对高温、洪涝、水资源压力和海平面上升的长期动态路线图；政府把2026年确定为气候适应年。
records.summary_en: Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong described Singapore's first National Adaptation Plan as a long-term living roadmap for heat, floods, water stress and sea-level rise. The government designated 2026 as the Year of Climate Adaptation.
records.source_zh: 新加坡总理公署
records.source_en: Prime Minister's Office

records.title_zh: 新加坡允许结转2025排放年度未使用的国际碳信用额度
records.title_en: Singapore allows unused 2025 international carbon credit offsets to be carried forward
records.summary_zh: 纳税设施每年可用合格国际碳信用抵销最多5%的应税排放。因第六条信用供给仍需时间形成，2025年度未使用额度可按25新元与45新元碳税税率换算后结转至2026年度。
records.summary_en: Taxable facilities may use eligible international carbon credits for up to 5% of taxable emissions. Unused 2025 capacity can be converted at the S$25-to-S$45 carbon-tax ratio and carried into 2026 while Article 6 supply develops.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局与永续发展与环境部
records.source_en: National Environment Agency and Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡为2031至2032年新增氢能就绪发电能力招标
records.title_en: Singapore tenders hydrogen-ready generation capacity for 2031 and 2032
records.summary_zh: 能源市场管理局招标一台2031年投运、最多两台2032年投运的氢能就绪联合循环燃气机组，每台至少600兆瓦，以应对未来十年峰值需求预计每年增长2.4%至4.8%。
records.summary_en: EMA tendered one hydrogen-ready combined-cycle gas unit for 2031 and up to two for 2032, each at least 600 MW, as peak demand is projected to grow 2.4–4.8% annually over the next decade.
records.source_zh: 新加坡能源市场管理局
records.source_en: Energy Market Authority

records.title_zh: 新加坡启动下一代地热系统可行性研究
records.title_en: Singapore launches a feasibility study on next-generation geothermal systems
records.summary_zh: 研究将评估地热发电、供热与制冷的技术、环境和商业可行性，并在全国无损地球物理调查基础上识别后续研究区域及潜在项目政策框架。
records.summary_en: The study will assess technical, environmental and commercial feasibility for geothermal power, heating and cooling and use a nationwide non-invasive geophysical survey to identify further study areas and possible policy frameworks.
records.source_zh: 新加坡能源市场管理局
records.source_en: Energy Market Authority

records.title_zh: 新加坡公共部门启动能源节约行动
records.title_en: Singapore's public sector launches an energy-conservation drive
records.summary_zh: 面对燃料供应链波动，新加坡要求各政府部门和法定机构在不影响运行的前提下降低设施用电，并推动企业与家庭共同提升能源韧性。
records.summary_en: In response to fuel-supply disruption, Singapore directed ministries and statutory boards to reduce electricity use where operationally feasible and encouraged businesses and households to strengthen energy resilience.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家环境局与永续发展与环境部
records.source_en: National Environment Agency and Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment

records.title_zh: 新加坡能源转型聚焦电力进口、太阳能与低碳技术储备
records.title_en: Singapore's energy transition focuses on power imports, solar and readiness for low-carbon technologies
records.summary_zh: 能源市场管理局提出在可靠、可负担和减排之间保持平衡：2030年太阳能目标为2吉瓦峰值，2035年前计划进口约6吉瓦低碳电力，并评估碳捕集封存、地热等技术。
records.summary_en: EMA's approach balances reliability, affordability and emissions reduction. Singapore targets 2 GWp of solar by 2030, around 6 GW of low-carbon electricity imports by 2035, and is assessing CCS and geothermal options.
records.source_zh: 新加坡能源市场管理局
records.source_en: Energy Market Authority

records.title_zh: 新加坡、黄金标准与Verra发布第6.2条碳信用协议
records.title_en: Singapore, Gold Standard and Verra publish the Article 6.2 Crediting Protocol
records.summary_zh: 协议为政府使用独立信用机制的登记、监测报告核查、签发和管理基础设施提供标准化路径，旨在降低政府与项目开发方落实第6.2条合作的不确定性。
records.summary_en: The protocol provides a standardised route for governments to use independent crediting infrastructure for registration, MRV, issuance and management, reducing uncertainty in Article 6.2 cooperation.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat

records.title_zh: 新加坡采购217.5万吨第六条自然类碳信用
records.title_en: Singapore will procure 2.175 million tonnes of Article 6-aligned nature-based carbon credits
records.summary_zh: 国家气候变化秘书处和贸工部将从加纳、秘鲁和巴拉圭四个项目采购217.5万吨高质量自然类碳信用，用于实现2030年国家自主贡献；采购合同总值约7600万新元。
records.summary_en: NCCS and MTI will procure 2.175 million tonnes of high-quality nature-based credits from four projects in Ghana, Peru and Paraguay for Singapore's 2030 NDC, at an approximate value of S$76 million.
records.source_zh: 新加坡国家气候变化秘书处与贸工部
records.source_en: National Climate Change Secretariat and Ministry of Trade and Industry
